cells.tense: You are following the pattern down and you are not forcing the pace.
cells.ask: Ask someone how they arrived at their number, then move one of yours by what comes back.
cells.core:
Following a pattern down, you still come back with something usable. When a thing opens up you go in, and you can tell the part that has a use from the part that is only shape. Nothing you notice has to be sold. You report what you see from inside it, and it lands because you are not pressing.

What keeps this steady is checking the understanding against someone else's. Fairness here is not a mood, it is a habit: you keep testing whether the share you are holding matches what is actually there. Take what you find to one person who will weigh it honestly.
cells.sheetLine: You follow the pattern and know when to stop pressing.
cells.verb: following a pattern deeper than words reach
cells.place: where the shares get weighed again

cells.tense: In every room you are already preparing the version of this that will finally explain it.
cells.ask: Write the whole picture in four lines, show it to one person, and leave it there.
cells.core:
The working version is simple: the pattern gets followed, and part of it comes back as a shape another person can use. What you are doing instead is explaining ahead of the thing. You have the full map drawn for a conversation that has not started, and you are already defending positions nobody has questioned.

It feels like rigor. It is closer to bracing. What holds is structure that serves what it organizes — say what you know clearly, once, and let it land. The depth is not the point; the reach is. What you find is worth more handed over than held.
cells.sheetLine: You explain before the shape has settled, and lose the room.

cells.tense: You had a real pattern in your hands once and you have been reading from that page since.
cells.ask: Walk one person through the thing you see, out loud, as slow as it takes.
cells.core:
Gone far into how something fits together, the working version brings back the piece that helps. The pattern gets followed, and some of it comes home as something another person can hold, and that is the part you have been skipping. The work has gone private. What people see is someone steady who has nothing to hand over.

The depth is not what is missing. It is the ladder back up. Give one thing you see to one person and let them hold it badly at first. What you know wants to be shared before it wants to be finished.
cells.sheetLine: You went private with the real thinking and stopped bringing it back.

cells.tense: You are already standing back and seeing how it all fits while calling it just being sensible.
cells.ask: Say one thing you understood last week and name it as yours, no hedge.
cells.core:
Standing back, the whole shape comes clear — the long arc, how the parts go together, what is fair once everything is counted. That is not what most people do. It is a particular way of seeing, and the people around you quietly get the benefit of it without either side naming it. That is the part running, and it has been running a while.

Something settled in you when you stopped arguing with that view, and it has not been said out loud. Name one thing you understood before anyone else did and let it be yours. Not a report. The sentence you would say if nobody had to agree.
cells.sheetLine: You see the wide view already and call it being sensible.
